subject: Money
title: The History of Income Tax
description: Learn The History of Income Tax in one minute.

hook.text: The U.S. income tax started in 1861 to fund the Civil War. It was supposed to be temporary.

buildup.text: Britain introduced income tax in 1799 to fight Napoleon. Same pattern: wars create taxes.

discovery.text: The 16th Amendment made U.S. income tax permanent in 1913. The top rate was 7%. It hit 94% by 1944.

twist.text: Temporary war taxes become permanent peacetime taxes. Governments rarely give back revenue streams.

climax.text: Every major tax expansion followed a crisis. Fear opens wallets that peace can't close.

punchline.text: Nothing lasts like a temporary tax.

quiz.question: What event led to the first U.S. income tax?
